title: The Great Billboard Equal Steel Pillars
statement:
You are installing a billboard and want it to have the largest height. The billboard will have two steel supports, one on each side. Each support must be an equal height.
You are given an array of rods which can be welded together (e.g. rods 1, 2, 3 can be welded to length 6).
You cannot break rods.
Return the largest possible height of your billboard installation. If you cannot support the billboard, return 0.
inputFormat:
First line: Integer N.
Second line: N space-separated integers representing rod lengths.

sampleCases.explanation: We have two disjoint subsets with equal sum 6: [1, 2, 3] and [6].
